home.title: Welcome to Home
home.subtitle: Your command center starts empty
home.welcome:
This is your **Home** dashboard. Nothing here is pre-filled — panels populate only from tasks, goals, journal entries, and performance logs you add.

Want a daily briefing? Open **Seldom AI** and ask for one once you have some data.
home.completeMessage: You're all set. Add a task or goal to see Home come alive.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Capture what you need to do
tasks.welcome:
The **Tasks** tab is your inbox. Add items with due dates and categories — they'll show up on Home and Calendar automatically.

There are no sample tasks. Yours start from a blank list.
tasks.completeMessage: Got it. Add your first task whenever you're ready.

goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: Long-term targets with milestones
goals.welcome:
Use **Goals** for outcomes that take weeks or months — with milestones so progress stays visible.

Everything starts empty. Define goals that matter to you; Seldom AI can help you break them down.
goals.completeMessage: Goals are ready when you are.

college.title: Junior Prep
college.subtitle: Explore schools on your timeline
college.welcome:
**Junior Prep** helps rising juniors and seniors research schools, plan tests and visits, and track prep — nothing is pre-filled.

Deadlines and school lists come only from what you add.
college.completeMessage: Your prep workspace is ready when you are.

college-common-app.title: Common App
college-common-app.subtitle: Activities, essays, and résumé
college-common-app.welcome:
Manage **activities, awards, projects, essay themes, drafts, and your résumé** in one workspace.

Junior mode focuses on prep; senior mode adds personal statement and supplemental tracking.
college-common-app.completeMessage: Pick a sub-tab above to start.

college-timeline.title: Timeline
college-timeline.subtitle: Deadlines in one view
college-timeline.welcome:
Your **application timeline** pulls deadlines from schools you add — not generic sample dates.

Add colleges first, then deadlines appear here.
college-timeline.completeMessage: Add schools to populate your timeline.

performance.title: Performance hub
performance.subtitle: Your sport or hobby workspace
performance.welcome:
This is your **performance hub**. Sessions, metrics, and notes all start blank — you log what matters.

Each sub-tab will introduce itself the first time you open it.
performance.completeMessage: Pick a sub-tab above to get started — Sessions is a good first stop.

journal.title: Journal
journal.subtitle: Reflect and debrief
journal.welcome:
The **Journal** is for reflections, session debriefs, and noting patterns over time.

Entries are searchable and feed into analytics — but only after you write them.
journal.completeMessage: Write your first entry when something worth remembering happens.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Deadlines from your data
calendar.welcome:
The **Calendar** pulls deadlines from tasks and goals you create — week, month, and list views.

It stays empty until you add items with due dates. You can export events or enable reminders in Settings.
calendar.completeMessage: Calendar will populate as you add dated tasks and goals.

analytics.title: Mission Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Advanced telemetry for your command center
analytics.welcome:
**Mission Analytics** is the deep-read layer of your command center — cross-domain trends once you've logged tasks, sessions, journal entries, or runs.

The tab stays hidden in the sidebar until there's data to chart — Home will tell you when it unlocks.
analytics.completeMessage: Keep logging — your telemetry board will fill in over time.

assistant.title: Seldom AI
assistant.subtitle: One assistant across Seldom
assistant.welcome:
**Seldom AI** handles daily plans, training ideas, goal breakdowns, college questions, and more — using your logged data when available.

You can ask anything anytime; context makes answers sharper.
assistant.completeMessage: Try asking what you'd like help with today.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Make Seldom yours
settings.welcome:
**Settings** holds theme, animations, your performance tab label, notifications, and the option to replay welcome setup.

Changes here apply immediately.

soccer-training.title: Practice sessions
soccer-training.subtitle: Log what you actually did
soccer-training.welcome:
Log **practice or training sessions** here — date, duration, intensity, and optional skill ratings.

Charts and trends appear only after you log sessions.

soccer-running.title: Cardio
soccer-running.subtitle: Runs and pace goals
soccer-running.welcome:
Track **runs** with distance, time, and notes. Set pace goals if you want targets to work toward.

Everything is relative to your own goals — nothing is pre-seeded.
soccer-running.completeMessage: Log a run or set a goal to begin.

soccer-gym.title: Gym
soccer-gym.subtitle: Strength and lifting sessions
soccer-gym.welcome:
Log **gym workouts** here — duration, type, and notes. Weekly volume charts build from what you log.

This tab only appears if you said you work out during performance setup.

soccer-matches.title: Events
soccer-matches.subtitle: Record appearances — no subjective ratings
soccer-matches.welcome:
Log **events or competitions** here — date, context, duration, and notes.

We skip subjective ratings. Focus on facts you can track: time spent, contributions, and what went well.
soccer-matches.completeMessage: Your event log starts empty. Add entries as they happen.

steps.question: What level do you usually compete at? (Optional — helps Seldom OS give better context)

soccer-technical.title: Skills
soccer-technical.subtitle: Self-assessed attributes
soccer-technical.welcome:
**Skills** are self-rated attributes (1–20 style) you define for yourself.

They stay at zero until you set them — either here or through session ratings over time.
soccer-technical.completeMessage: Rate yourself when you're ready, or let session logs build the picture.

soccer-physical.title: Physical metrics
soccer-physical.subtitle: Baselines optional — progress is relative
soccer-physical.welcome:
This tab tracks **physical metrics** — speed, endurance, strength benchmarks, and similar.

You can **set baselines now** or **leave everything at zero**. All progress is measured relative to *your* goals, not preset numbers.
soccer-physical.completeMessage: Add baselines when you want them, or start logging and build from zero.

steps.question: How do you want to start?
options: Leave at zero for now — I'll log as I go
I'll set baselines when I have numbers
Ask Seldom OS to help me choose metrics

soccer-weaknesses.title: Development areas
soccer-weaknesses.subtitle: What you're working on
soccer-weaknesses.welcome:
Track **weaknesses and development areas** you want to improve — prioritized by what matters most to you.

Nothing is pre-filled. Add items as you identify them, or ask Seldom OS for suggestions based on your logs.
soccer-weaknesses.completeMessage: Add development areas when you're ready.

soccer-strengths.title: Strengths
soccer-strengths.subtitle: What you do well
soccer-strengths.welcome:
Document your **strengths** so you know what to lean on during practice and performance.

This stays empty until you add them — no generic lists.
soccer-strengths.completeMessage: Note your strengths as you discover them.

soccer-coach.title: AI Coach
soccer-coach.subtitle: Performance-specific guidance
soccer-coach.welcome:
The **AI Coach** gives performance-specific advice based on your training logs, goals, and notes.

It won't invent data — ask for a plan or review once you've logged some sessions.
soccer-coach.completeMessage: Generate insights after you have logged sessions.

soccer-progress.title: Progress charts
soccer-progress.subtitle: Trends from your logs
soccer-progress.welcome:
**Progress charts** visualize training load, intensity, and session trends from what you log.

Charts appear after you have sessions — no demo data.
soccer-progress.completeMessage: Log sessions to see trends here.
